main_text.p: successores dicti sunt Chalifæ, i.e. Vicarii vel summi Pontifices; & E-miri[?] erant Præfecti Imperii. Africâ, Cypro, Rhodo cum Galliæ parte potiti à Sina usq; ad Herculis Columnas cuncta terrarum nationumq; in mores, lingvam, religionemque suam corruperunt.
Divisum fuit in V Chalifa-tus:Divisio in Andalusiæ, Fessæ, Kairoüanni, Ægypti & Bagdadi.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Hæc divisio cœpit A.C. 756. Et hac ratione inexpugnabilis illa imperii Saracenici moles dissipata inu-tilibus bellis debilitata fuit.
main_text.head: CHALIFATUS ANDA-LUSIÆ.

page.notes: Reading of "Emiri" (line 3) is uncertain: the i is damaged. The catchword "Ex" at lower right was read from a faint mark. The italic status of some words in the first paragraph (Africâ, Cypro, Rhodo, Galliæ parte) is inferred from the scan. The Greek and Latin spellings are reproduced as printed.
